integrity.geometric_input_basis: McMullen Corollary 2 explicitly attributes to Getzler the compositional inverse relation for Euler-characteristic generating functions and gives a full stable-tree proof.
integrity.originality_basis: A 2025 full-text treatment of the same Euler characteristics was searched for parity, mod 4, 2-adic, and divisibility terminology with no matching statement.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The bibliographic record for Getzler lists 14H10 among its leading algebraic-geometry classifications.

scientific_limitations: Only the total topological Euler characteristic is treated; individual Betti numbers and odd-prime valuations are not classified.
The proof is an arithmetic consequence of the classical genus-zero inversion formula, so an unindexed prior congruence may exist.
title: A mod-four law for Euler characteristics of stable pointed rational curves
